nd5b0ef2213.headline: Azerbaijan imported gold worth 5.1 billion US dollars in 11 months
nd5b0ef2213.summary: Azerbaijan imported gold worth $5.1 billion in January to November of this year. The figure was reported by Apa.az.
nd5b0ef2213.why: Gold imports and reserves are watched as indicators of demand and external trade flows, and gold is a benchmark store of value for central banks.

n48c679175f.headline: Government scraps duty on fuel in transit
n48c679175f.summary: Zimbabwe has scrapped duties and taxes on fuel in transit, gazetted under Finance Act Number 7. The Shipping and Forwarding Agents' Association of Zimbabwe welcomed the move.
n48c679175f.why: Duties on transit fuel affect the cost of moving petroleum products through landlocked Zimbabwe to neighbouring markets, influencing freight and fuel logistics.

na29091d58c.headline: Milan Stock Exchange Edges Up in Final 2025 Session, Banks and Oil Strong, Luxury Weak
na29091d58c.summary: Piazza Affari opened the final 2025 session with a modest gain, with the Milan exchange on track for a strong year, second only to Spain among major European markets. Banks and oil stocks were strong while luxury shares lagged.
na29091d58c.why: Borsa Italiana operates the Milan Stock Exchange, Italy's main equity market, and the FTSE MIB is its benchmark index of the largest listed companies.

n8331759fe5.headline: Greece attracts buyers from 110 countries - €1.5 billion in revenue from property sales
n8331759fe5.summary: Greece has attracted buyers from 110 countries, generating €1.5 billion in property sales revenue. Greek expatriates, mainly from the US and Australia, account for much of the interest, with 84% of 671 residences sold or reserved.
n8331759fe5.why: Foreign property demand is a significant source of capital and economic activity for Greece, which relies on tourism and real estate investment.

nf6ecd91f95.headline: Georgia expands free trade zone on the border with Azerbaijan
nf6ecd91f95.summary: The Georgian government issued new permits for free trade and warehousing activities near the Red Bridge border checkpoint with Azerbaijan. The expansion adds trade and logistics capacity at the crossing.
nf6ecd91f95.why: Free trade zones and bonded warehousing facilitate cross-border trade and logistics, which can attract investment in border regions.

ne8ccb3f64c.headline: Malawi: Rotten ADMARC Maize Flour Sold to Staff As
ne8ccb3f64c.summary: About 132 tonnes of maize flour at the Agricultural Development and Marketing Corporation reportedly rotted in warehouses and was diverted to staff. The flour was reportedly infested with worms and mould.
ne8ccb3f64c.why: ADMARC is Malawi's state agricultural marketing body, and its grain stocks affect food security and price stability.

nbd597ba93a.headline: Executive Director: SOFAZ considers risks and uncertainties related to oil and gas sector
nbd597ba93a.summary: The State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan's budget for next year is prepared alongside the state budget, with oil price assumptions based on medium-term forecasts from international organisations, its executive director said.
nbd597ba93a.why: SOFAZ is Azerbaijan's sovereign wealth fund, financed largely by oil and gas revenues. Its budget assumptions depend on oil price forecasts that are sensitive to global crude markets.

nd13f964cab.headline: Azerbaijan bans import, production and sale of electronic cigarettes
nd13f964cab.summary: Azerbaijan has prohibited the import, export, production, storage, wholesale and retail sale, and use of electronic cigarettes and their components. The ban covers the full supply chain.
nd13f964cab.why: Bans on consumer products create regulatory risk for tobacco and vaping companies and distributors operating in affected markets.

n5c948c2f8a.headline: Rupee Rises 14 Paise To Close At 89.84 Against The US Dollar
n5c948c2f8a.summary: The rupee rose 14 paise to close at 89.84 against the US dollar, aided by RBI dollar selling and strong IIP data showing a 25-month high of 6.7%. Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower.
n5c948c2f8a.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, foreign investment returns and inflation in India, and the Reserve Bank of India intervenes in the currency market.

n40b6eca042.headline: Tesla quarterly deliveries seen falling as lack of tax credits, competition sap demand
n40b6eca042.summary: Tesla deliveries were expected to fall in the fourth quarter as the loss of US tax credits and rising global competition sapped demand. The company rolled out cheaper versions of its best-selling EVs.
n40b6eca042.why: Tesla is the world's largest pure-play electric vehicle maker, so its delivery trends are closely watched as a gauge of EV demand and of competitive pressure in the sector.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Expected lower quarterly deliveries point to weaker near-term vehicle sales for Tesla.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n40b6eca042.why_moved: Expected falling deliveries after the loss of US tax credits and growing competition point to weaker demand for Tesla's vehicles.

n4096d701d8.headline: Greece Advances Long-Delayed Sale-and-Leaseback Scheme to Final Bidding Stage - Dnews
n4096d701d8.summary: Greece has moved closer to launching a sale-and-leaseback mechanism to protect vulnerable borrowers' homes, under Law 4738/2020. The finance ministry published a call for binding investor offers.
n4096d701d8.why: Sale-and-leaseback schemes let indebted homeowners sell property and rent it back, and they affect Greek banks' non-performing loan exposure.

n2c87a77b54.headline: Metlen Expands Cross-Border Gas Flows with First US LNG Delivery to Bulgaria - Dnews
n2c87a77b54.summary: The first liquefied natural gas cargo sourced from the United States and destined exclusively for Bulgaria arrived at the Alexandroupolis floating terminal in Greece. The shipment marks a shift in regional gas flows.
n2c87a77b54.why: Metlen is a Greek industrial group with energy operations, and LNG import flows shape gas supply security and pricing across Southeast Europe.

ndd042972d5.headline: Is Iran’s Tiananmen moment a sign bazaar protests will topple the regime?
ndd042972d5.summary: Protests are sweeping Iran, with the bazaar class prominent amid economic collapse and rising calls for regime change, according to media reports. The developments are described as a major political challenge.
ndd042972d5.why: Iran's economic conditions and political stability affect global oil supply expectations and sanctions-related trade, which matter to energy and commodity investors.

n3615cb520f.headline: Octopus Energy sells stake in software arm Kraken, valuing unit at £6.4bn
n3615cb520f.summary: Octopus Energy has sold a stake in its software arm Kraken, valuing the unit at £6.4bn. The move paves the way for a demerger of Kraken Technologies and a possible stock market flotation.
n3615cb520f.why: Octopus Energy is a UK energy supplier whose Kraken software platform runs billing and customer systems, and its valuation and listing plans signal investor appetite for energy-tech assets.

n917c86f903.headline: Stock Market Today, Dec. 30: Boeing Led Industrials as Major Indexes Drift Near Records
n917c86f903.summary: On Dec. 30, 2025, Boeing led industrials as major US indexes drifted in quiet year-end trading near record territory.
n917c86f903.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance.

impacts.name: Boeing
impacts.why: Boeing led industrial stocks on the day.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n2aacfae38a.headline: Genting Vista issues RM3bil unrated medium-term notes
n2aacfae38a.summary: Genting Bhd's wholly-owned subsidiary Genting Vista Bhd issued an unrated medium-term notes programme of RM3.0 billion in nominal value (Series 1). The issue sits under its RM5 billion unrated MTN programme.
n2aacfae38a.why: Genting Berhad is a Malaysian conglomerate with interests in leisure, plantations and power. Medium-term note issuance is a common way for large corporates to raise debt funding.

n0a230ddc09.headline: What is Manus, the Singapore-based AI startup acquired for US$2 billion by Meta?
n0a230ddc09.summary: Meta has acquired Manus, a Singapore-based AI startup, for US$2 billion. The startup's platform can complete tasks such as resume screening, financial document analysis and stock analysis.
n0a230ddc09.why: Meta Platforms is a major US technology company investing heavily in artificial intelligence, and acquisitions of AI startups signal its strategy to expand capabilities.

n5c0350b9a1.headline: Octopus Energy to spin off $8.65bn tech arm Kraken
n5c0350b9a1.summary: Octopus Energy is selling a $1bn stake in its technology arm Kraken, paving the way for a demerger. The spin-off values the technology business at $8.65bn.
n5c0350b9a1.why: Octopus Energy is a UK energy supplier, and Kraken is its software platform used to run energy and utility billing and customer systems for other firms.

nb9f852f96d.headline: Otedola sells shares in Geregu Power for N1trn as Yari...
nb9f852f96d.summary: Femi Otedola, chairman of First Holdco, has sold his majority stake in Geregu Power Plc for N1.088 trillion. The deal is financed by a consortium of banks.
nb9f852f96d.why: Geregu Power is a Nigerian electricity generator, and power-sector stakes are key to the country's electricity supply and investor interest. Bank-financed deals signal capital flows in Nigeria's energy sector.

n49b7bea538.headline: Ghana Legalises Trading in Virtual Assets
n49b7bea538.summary: Trading in virtual assets such as cryptocurrency is now legal in Ghana. Parliament passed the Virtual Asset Service Providers Bill into law.
n49b7bea538.why: Clear legal frameworks for crypto service providers determine whether exchanges can operate and attract institutional capital. Ghana is a West African economy with a growing fintech sector.

n4ec9d94587.headline: Nigeria: Up-Close - Meet the New Owners of Geregu Power
n4ec9d94587.summary: Geregu Power said it was formally notified by Amperion Power Distribution Company of a share sale to Ma'am Energy Limited. The company informed the Nigerian Exchange.
n4ec9d94587.why: Geregu Power is a Nigerian electricity generator, and ownership changes in power assets affect investor views of the sector's governance and capital flows.

n397502d41b.headline: Iran’s president pledges ‘harsh’ response on back of Trump warning
n397502d41b.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian pledged a harsh response to a Trump warning, in a post on social media platform X.
n397502d41b.why: Exchanges of threats between Iran and the United States raise geopolitical risk for oil supply and regional markets.

nc96926a210.headline: From brothers to rivals: Key moments in Saudi-UAE relations​
nc96926a210.summary: Saudi Arabia and the UAE, once the twin pillars of regional security, have seen their interests diverge on oil quotas and geopolitical influence, according to a historical overview.
nc96926a210.why: Saudi Arabia and the UAE are the Gulf's largest oil producers, and their policy differences can affect OPEC+ output decisions and regional risk.

n78be41a55f.headline: Ringgit ends firmer vs US$, major currencies
n78be41a55f.summary: The ringgit ended slightly higher against the US dollar and other major currencies on Tuesday. Improved buying interest drove the move.
n78be41a55f.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves affect the cost of imports and returns for foreign investors in Malaysian assets.

n9f09c49fe4.headline: Network18 defies industry slowdown; Rahul Joshi charts bold growth path for 2026
n9f09c49fe4.summary: Network18 has grown despite a year in which advertising-led media companies faced shrinking revenues, declining viewership and industry consolidation, according to its executive.
n9f09c49fe4.why: Network18 is an Indian media and broadcasting group, and its performance reflects the state of India's advertising-funded media sector.

n424b02d683.headline: Trump’s tariffs and soaring wage costs ensure rocky year for UK economy
n424b02d683.summary: Experts warned 2026 looks set to be another 'sluggish year' for the UK, with few policies to spur private sector growth. Trump's tariffs and rising wage costs are cited as pressures.
n424b02d683.why: The UK economy's growth outlook shapes gilt yields, sterling and the earnings prospects of domestically focused British companies.

n8935afec03.headline: Scammers notched $333 million from bitcoin ATM scams in 2025, FBI says
n8935afec03.summary: The FBI says fraudsters in 2025 defrauded Americans of more than $333 million using bitcoin ATM machines. The figure covers scams perpetrated through these machines.
n8935afec03.why: Bitcoin ATMs convert cash into crypto, and regulators have increasingly scrutinised them as a channel for fraud.

ncd9abcdf8c.headline: Sensex, Nifty End Slightly Lower In Thin Year-End Trade, Foreign Fund Selling Weighs On Markets
ncd9abcdf8c.summary: Indian stock markets closed marginally lower amid thin year-end trading and continued foreign fund outflows. The Sensex fell 20 points while the Nifty ended almost flat.
ncd9abcdf8c.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indices of India's stock market, and foreign institutional flows are a key driver of their direction.

n2662f7f16a.headline: UK households still unwilling to spend in 2026 over cost of living concerns
n2662f7f16a.summary: A survey found UK households appear reluctant to spend going into 2026 because of cost of living concerns. The findings point to subdued consumer confidence.
n2662f7f16a.why: Consumer spending drives a large share of the UK economy, so weak household spending matters for retailers and growth forecasts. Surveys of spending intentions are an early indicator of demand.

nec0f916a12.headline: China allocates $8.9 billion fund for 2026 consumer goods trade-in scheme
nec0f916a12.summary: China has allocated 62.5 billion yuan, about $8.94 billion, in ultra-long special treasury bond funds for its consumer goods trade-in scheme in 2026, according to state media.
nec0f916a12.why: Trade-in subsidies support household consumption and demand for durable goods such as autos and appliances. Government fiscal support is a key driver of China's domestic economy.

ne35ec0a8ca.headline: Wagamama making unwelcome change to UK restaurants after law change
ne35ec0a8ca.summary: Wagamama is the latest hospitality firm reportedly eyeing price hikes in the new year, following a change in the law. The article does not give details of the size of the increases.
ne35ec0a8ca.why: Wagamama is a UK-based restaurant chain owned by Restaurant Brands, and menu pricing reflects cost pressures across the hospitality sector.

n1c29d119f4.headline: Trump’s tariffs and soaring wage costs ensure rocky year for UK economy
n1c29d119f4.summary: Experts warned 2026 looks set to be another sluggish year for the UK economy, with few policies to spur private sector growth. Trump's tariffs and soaring wage costs were cited as headwinds.
n1c29d119f4.why: The UK is Europe's second-largest economy by many measures, and sustained weak growth affects sterling, gilt yields and UK-listed company earnings.

n2bf5d9dc45.headline: India claims overtaking Japan as world
n2bf5d9dc45.summary: India suggests its fast-growing economy has surpassed Japan to become the fourth largest in the world. Officials hope it could pass Germany within a set period.
n2bf5d9dc45.why: Relative economy size shapes long-term capital allocation, currency expectations and emerging-market investment flows.

nebe6d2be44.headline: Stock Market Today, Dec. 30: Nio Rallies on Upbeat Q4 Sales Outlook
nebe6d2be44.summary: Nio shares continued to climb on December 30 as investors reacted to a $4.3 billion sales outlook and an extension of a China subsidy.
nebe6d2be44.why: Nio is a Chinese electric vehicle maker, so its sales outlook and China's EV subsidy policy directly affect its revenue and demand.
nebe6d2be44.why_moved: Investors reacted to a $4.3 billion sales outlook and a China subsidy extension, both of which support expected vehicle demand.

n30852ff9d3.headline: China flexes blockade capabilities near Taiwan on second day of military drills
n30852ff9d3.summary: The People's Liberation Army sent destroyers, frigates, fighters and bombers to waters north and south of Taiwan on the second day of military drills. The exercises follow earlier drills described in the reports.
n30852ff9d3.why: Military tensions around Taiwan affect shipping routes and semiconductor supply chains, since Taiwan hosts major chip manufacturing.
